title: Dispatch process hygiene: architecture follow-ups (one home for the tree proof, the grace time, the root key and the sweep state)
routed_reason: the kill path of the bridge and gc (internal/proctree); the console owns it
source: console, 2026-10-08, architecture review of lane H2 (cl-proc-hygiene), verdict Approve, MEDIUM and LOW items after fix round 3
summary: Five items from the architecture review. M1: gc/dispatch_processes.go:48 rebuilds the recorded-tree half of OwnedByDispatch from primitives. M2: the 2 s grace time has two homes (bridge/dispatch_reap.go:27, cmd/evolve/cmd_gc_dispatch.go:16). M3: gc.ProjectRootEnvKey is one more home for EVOLVE_PROJECT_ROOT; the writer in subagentrun/env.go:53 uses a bare literal. M4: Deps.sweep holds per-dispatch mutable state in the dependency bag. L1: gc loads the persisted tree once for each check.
fix: M1: export the tree half as one named proof (for example proctree.InRecordedTree) and use it in OwnedByDispatch and in gc. M2: one proctree.DefaultGrace for both callers. M3: one shared constant for EVOLVE_PROJECT_ROOT, used by the writer and by gc (own refactor commit). M4: carry the sweep on the per-launch state, not on Deps. L1: load each tree once per gc run.
acceptance: gc and the bridge decide ownership only through proctree compositions, with a test that changes the tree half once and sees both callers follow
One grace constant; a grep finds no second 2 * time.Second for the reap
EVOLVE_PROJECT_ROOT has one constant home that the writer and gc both use
Deps carries no per-dispatch mutable sweep state
A gc run loads each persisted tree at most once
